caption: The drawing depicts a horse-drawn cart or wagon. There are two horses, both brown in color with bridles and reins, positioned side by side and harnessed to the front of the cart. The wagon has four large spoked wheels and an open cab with no door on the side facing the viewer. The body of the cart is primarily green with a decorative circular pattern along the lower edge and a black roof that appears worn. A large red panel on the side displays yellow lettering that reads "G.A. SCHWARZ TOYS FANCY GOODS 1006 CHESTNUT ST. PHILA PA." The interior of the cart is plain and appears empty. The drawing is rendered on a plain light background with no additional objects or scenery present.
title: Toy Wagon
